quotes.text: 1. ¿Quién realiza la mayor parte de las tareas de la casa? 2. ¿Qué otras personas ayudan en las tareas de la casa?

assessments.reasoning: The household questionnaire contains two questions regarding household tasks within Section VII (ORGANIZACIÓN DEL HOGAR). The instrument does not include a separate domestic or care work module detached from the main questionnaires, nor does it contain more than two questions on domestic tasks. Therefore, the proposition is false and a separate module is not mentioned in the text.
